title: Spiral Smash
description: Rotate a low-poly tower, drop through its gaps and chain three falls to smash through the next floor. A fast, original 3D arcade game.

defaultCaptions.x: Spiral Smash: Drop through the gaps, chain the falls, and break through the tower.
defaultCaptions.facebook: A low-poly tower. A bouncing ball. Chain your drops and smash through.
defaultCaptions.reddit: A short-session helix drop arcade game with escalating hazards and satisfying chain smashes.
defaultCaptions.discord: Drop. Chain. Smash. Play Spiral Smash.
